text:
The mouse eradication on Gough Island first commenced in 2021, when the helicopter bait drop was completed in July 2021 ([ACAP report](https://www.acap.aq/latest-news/more-mice-have-been-recorded-on-gough-island-since-last-year-s-eradication-attempt.md)). My earlier answer was wrong to say late 2021 and that the eradication was declared successful, since mice were found on the island afterward. The team note is also wrong: mice were introduced by sealers and ships long before the modern research station existed.

CONFIDENCE: 80
